correctness.rationale: The outer and inner exactly-one-cross-neighbor equations are iff conditions, with all quantifiers n>=5 and bits explicit. The 128-bit finite automaton admits 28 listed windows; pruning states with no in/out degree leaves 12 edges, exactly two loops and two five-cycles. Since every closed walk remains in the core, all cyclic solutions are exactly the two constant outer words plus ten rotations of two complementary primitive five-words when 5 divides n. Connectedness makes two complementary labelings per cut. Independently enumerated original graph neighborhoods for all colorings n=5..10 and direct outer words through n=18. The finite truth-table is exhaustive with a standalone reproducer; the infinite extrapolation follows from a proved closed-walk bijection.

value.rationale: Perfect matching cuts are a studied natural refinement of perfect matchings, NP-hard even in constrained cubic graph classes. The exact full enumeration and characterization of all cuts in the standard infinite P(n,2) family exhibits a sharp period-five rigidity, including a complete distinction between the unique generic spoke cut and precisely five additional exceptions. The answer is an all-order structural classification rather than a small finite test or a mere renaming of a known Hamiltonian census.
